title: Stop Saying "Very Important"! 5 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very important". Try one of these instead:
• Crucial: sleep is crucial for your health
• Essential: water is essential for life
• Vital: it is vital to wear a seat belt
• Critical: the next few minutes are critical
• Paramount: safety is paramount

Which one will you use today? Write it in the comments.
